text: What is the defining property of an autoconceptor relative to the standard (batch) conceptor?
choices: It updates C incrementally online via matrix gradient descent and converges to the same offline conceptor R(R + alpha^-2 I)^-1
It modifies the reservoir's recurrent weights online to store the pattern
It replaces the aperture with a learned per-neuron length scale
It stores each pattern as a fixed-point attractor instead of a subspace
explanation: An autoconceptor does online gradient descent on the same convex objective and converges (under Robbins-Monro conditions) to the batch conceptor R(R + alpha^-2 I)^-1. The reservoir weights are never modified, which is why there is no catastrophic forgetting. Per-neuron length scales belong to ARD/GP readouts; conceptors store subspaces, not fixed points.
